name: Camping 101: Engineering
summary: An engineer in Kharanos can learn to craft a Reagent Bot for a camp. The bot helps keep you supplied with materials for spells.

sections.title: A Camp's Supplies
sections.body: An engineer can learn from Bronk Guzzlegear in Kharanos how to make a Reagent Bot. You need to show proficiency in your engineering skill before he teaches you. The bot helps supply materials that you and your allies need for spells.

sections.title: Ready for the Wilds
sections.body: You can now craft a Reagent Bot. To test it, leave the town and head into the wilderness, where you can set up camp. Bring a campfire too; cooks can teach you how to make one.

faq.q: Who teaches me to make a Reagent Bot?
faq.answer: Bronk Guzzlegear in Kharanos can teach you to craft a Reagent Bot once you show proficiency in engineering.

faq.q: What does a Reagent Bot do?
faq.answer: A Reagent Bot helps keep you and your allies supplied with materials needed for spells.

faq.q: What do I need before I can learn this?
faq.answer: You need to show proficiency in your engineering skill before Bronk Guzzlegear teaches you to craft a Reagent Bot.

faq.q: Where can I try out the Reagent Bot?
faq.answer: You can test the Reagent Bot in the wilderness, since most folk do not want camps set up in the center of town.
Yes. A camp needs a campfire, and most cooks can teach you to make one.

angles.text: As an engineer, you can learn from Bronk Guzzlegear to craft a Reagent Bot for your camp.
As a cook, you can teach others to make the campfire needed for a camp.
